facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.title: hazard report - pressure exposure at PSV-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 July 2013 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
